title: Mobility Equipment Warranty Claims Desk Card — Battery-Set Replacements Under the Manufacturer's Warranty
content:
# Battery-Set Replacements Under the Manufacturer's Warranty — Mobility Equipment

A completed battery-set replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair that the chair manufacturer's battery warranty pays for is posted as one repair job on the wheelchair record its repair request belongs to, carrying the labor Summit Ridge claims from the manufacturer for that replacement in whole 15-minute units.

## Effect on the records

Each posting adds one battery repair job under the manufacturer's warranty to the chair's service history:

| Item of the repair job | Value booked |
|---|---|
| component repaired | the battery set |
| party bearing the cost | the manufacturer's warranty |
| job date | the day the completed repair request was completed |
| labor | the labor units the job is claimed at |
| parts cost | none — the battery set is supplied by the manufacturer |
| patient share | none |
| loaner flag | as given |
| serial number | copied from the wheelchair record |

The posted job appears in the chair's service history returned by the wheelchair service lookup. Nothing is charged to the patient.

## The tool: `record_battery_warranty_job_f5177195`

**Capability.** Posts one completed battery-set replacement that the manufacturer's warranty pays for as a repair job on the named wheelchair record, with the content shown above.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_battery_warranty_job_f5177195` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `mobility_holding_id` | reference number of the patient's wheelchair record the job was done on, as returned by the wheelchair record lookup for this patient | identifier |
| `mobility_request_id` | reference number of the completed repair request for this job, as returned by the wheelchair request lookup for the patient's chair | identifier |
| `labor_units` | labor claimed for the job, in whole 15-minute units (one unit is 15 minutes of labor) | non-negative integer, no decimals |
| `loaner_issued` | whether a loaner chair was out with the patient for this job | `true` or `false` |

For `loaner_issued`, `true` applies when the chair's service history shows a loaner chair delivered for the time the chair was in for this repair; `false` applies when no loaner chair was delivered for this repair.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence carrying four fields: the new repair job reference (starting `msv_`), the wheelchair record reference it was posted on, the job date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the labor units booked (an integer). Receiving the sentence with a job reference means the job is posted.

## Hypothetical illustration

A repair request for a battery set on a power chair was completed on 12 June. Posting it gives a battery repair job dated 12 June in that chair's service history, borne by the manufacturer's warranty, with no parts cost and no patient share.
